title: Quand le papier rencontre la caste
purpose: Show how a general state-legibility mechanism becomes socially consequential in Jaffna without turning caste into a parallel chronological spine.
reason_off_trunk: The caste mechanism is a vertical thread crossing arcs; it enriches the paper-state explanation but does not define a new rupture at this point.
payoff: The reader returns to colonial legibility understanding that documentation can harden pre-existing hierarchy without inventing it.

content.takeaway: Colonial registration can stabilize hierarchy while remaining a negotiated technology rather than a simple invention of caste.
